causal_patch.falsifier: candidate retains long stream synchronizations immediately after 256-byte H2D copies or violates exact output/accounting gates

candidate_trace_attribution.attribution_rule: Every wall interval is assigned once. Concurrent GPU intervals use the longest active kernel; idle intervals use active CUDA synchronization/launch APIs, then scheduler_gap.

phases.split_rule: Non-overlapping median-TTFT proxy: prefill ends at the median first-token timestamp; the remainder is decode.

intervention.candidate_path_gate: candidate audit must contain phase=runtime_invocation, candidate_path=ScheduleBatch.prepare_for_decode.pinned_async_penalty_tokens, batch_size=32, dtype=torch.int64, pin_memory=true, and non_blocking=true
intervention.falsifier: The candidate retains long stream synchronizations immediately after 256-byte H2D copies, lacks runtime-path proof, or violates 32/32 output, token, cache, or semantic gates.
intervention.source_justification: The bound Nsight SQLite contains 358 decode-time cudaStreamSynchronize calls of at least 10 ms immediately after 256-byte H2D copies, exactly matching 32 int64 latest-token IDs. Pinned SGLang v0.5.13 ScheduleBatch.prepare_for_decode uniquely constructs that tensor directly on CUDA while min_tokens=358 activates the penalizer. Building the same values in pinned host memory and enqueueing a nonblocking H2D preserves same-stream ordering; forward_stream.wait_stream(schedule_stream) preserves the consumer dependency.
